items.title: Find the tipping point in phase-change materials
items.hook: Many systems change gradually until one threshold causes a disproportionate shift. This prompt asks where that threshold might be.
items.experiment: Use a bounded stored-energy reserve as a first-order thermal-storage proxy. Vary storage capacity, replenishment and changing heat demand; measure the share of time demand is fully served.
items.question: Can a building stay comfortable with less active cooling?
items.caveat: The current resource model is only a storage-and-demand analogy; it does not simulate temperature, heat transfer, phase change or measured material properties.

items.title: Find the tipping point in neural plasticity
items.hook: Many systems change gradually until one threshold causes a disproportionate shift. This prompt asks where that threshold might be.
items.experiment: Represent software modules as a ring network with local dependencies. Remove modules at random and measure the largest surviving connected subsystem across repeated trials.
items.question: How does modular connectivity affect the resilience of adaptive software systems?
items.caveat: A graph-resilience analogy; it does not model neural tissue or software adaptation.

items.title: Find the tipping point in event detection
items.hook: Many systems change gradually until one threshold causes a disproportionate shift. This prompt asks where that threshold might be.
items.experiment: Deploy simple agents across a synthetic observation grid. Vary agent count, local exploration bias and blocked regions; measure reachable area explored after a fixed number of steps.
items.question: How does a distributed sensor swarm improve coverage when observations are incomplete?
items.caveat: Synthetic search-coverage model; not an astronomical event detector or observation forecast.
